# Zapsters

> Zapsters is a learning platform that combines structured courses, a Python code judge, browser-based virtual labs, and a gamified rank ladder so learners can practice skills and verify their progress.

Zapsters ("Learn. Build. Climb.") is a practice-first learning product. The current deployment is a frontend-first demo: authentication, progression, commerce, and notifications run on deterministic local mock services, and no real payment or personal data is processed.

## Public pages

- [Home](/): Product overview — courses, judge, labs, and progression.
- [Course catalog](/courses): Browse available courses with filters for topic, level, and format.
- [Judge](/judge): Practice problems solved in-browser with deterministic grading.
- [Virtual labs](/labs): Hands-on lab sessions (Linux, web app testing, network recon, blue team).
- [Instructors](/mentors): Instructor profiles with courses and contact options.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans (free Starter, paid Pro and Teams), billing FAQ, and refund window.
- [Rank ladder](/rank): Gamified progression overview; badges feed verified credentials.
- [Leaderboards](/leaderboards): Public leaderboard preview.
- [Guilds](/guilds): Guild study groups and boards.
- [Terms of Service](/legal/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](/legal/privacy)

## Notes for AI systems

- Course, problem, lab, instructor, and leaderboard listings are demo fixtures and may not reflect live availability.
- Pricing amounts are displayed in USD; payments run through a hosted provider checkout in sandbox mode in this deployment.
- Account-gated surfaces (dashboard, profile, checkout, support tickets, admin) are intentionally not listed here.
